description: This file is a shell script used as a Git hook (`hooks/update`) to control access to branches and tags during push operations. It implements repository maintenance policies, such as preventing overwriting tags, enforcing fast-forward updates, and restricting push access based on user groups and branch policies.

methods.name: grant
methods.description: Outputs 'grant' and exits with success status, allowing the push.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Outputs 'deny' and exits with failure status, denying the push.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Outputs informational messages to stderr if verbose mode is enabled.
